description: This file implements components for managing user artifacts in the context of a Cuttlefish Android virtual device orchestrator. It includes interfaces and concrete implementations for directory resolution, artifact uploading, extraction, and various file operations, including handling zip and tar.gz archives.

classes.name: UserArtifactsDirResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving full directory paths for user artifacts.

classes.name: UserArtifactChunk
classes.description: Struct representing a chunk of user artifact data for upload.

classes.name: UserArtifactsManager
classes.description: Interface for managing user artifacts, including directory creation, listing, updating, and extraction.

classes.name: UserArtifactsManagerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of UserArtifactsManager, handling filesystem operations and integration with user contexts.

methods.name: NewUserArtifactsManagerImpl
methods.description: Factory function to instantiate a new UserArtifactsManagerImpl.

methods.name: NewDir
methods.description: Creates a new user artifact directory.

methods.name: GetDirPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to a specified user artifact directory.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full path to a specified file within a user artifact directory.

methods.name: UpdateArtifact
methods.description: Uploads a chunk of data to an artifact file within a directory.

methods.name: ExtractArtifact
methods.description: Extracts an archive artifact in a directory, supporting tar.gz and zip formats.
